correctness.rationale: Exact SPD decomposition into pair-antisymmetric eigenvalues (1-b), pair-symmetric differences (1+b), and a 2×2 hub block. Diagonal Loewner sandwich convexity makes orbit-averaging rigorous. Perron positivity of the top generalized eigenvector forces every optimum to be orbit-constant. A sharp eigenvalue-crossing and AM–GM minimax proof yields both branches and Jacobi locus for all admissible real parameters. Replaying verify.py gave 1,799 deterministic numerical assertions across 126 cases; finite evidence is corroboration only.

value.rationale: This solves a natural complete structured diagonal preconditioning problem for a hub coupled to independent correlated pairs, with a rank-changing active eigenvalue constraint. The exact optimum, unique unrestricted scaler and sharp isolated Jacobi condition \(ma^2=b^2\) determine when inexpensive diagonal equilibration is fully optimal and how sparsity and system dimension change that decision. Unlike isolated low-order numerical examples, the result applies to every number of paired blocks and every admissible positive parameter.
